messages:
ada: Heads up — kicked off a tiny probe into surfacing cost by 'query path' (route → model variant → prefetch/cache hits). Thinking console panel + hover drilldown. Wanted input on telemetry shape + sensible defaults for sampling.

james: +1. Do we want per-invocation cost at 100% sample or rely on sampled extrapolation? Sampling affects heatmaps a lot.

ada: Ideally 100% for short window (last 1h) and sampled for long tails. We can do exact for recent 1m/1h, then reservoir-sample for >1h.

nina: For UX: show a small sparkline per route, then on click expand a breakdown: model variants, cache crediting, and a top-5 query-path table. Hover over model -> show median latency + unit cost.

ryan: Two quick asks: 1) routing policies need to expose which model SKU was selected (and why) in the trace so we can attribute cost to the selected SKU, not just the route. 2) quota/burst should be visible per-route in the same panel.

ada: Agreed on 1. Current telemetry includes model_sku but loses it when fallback happens. We need lineage: original_request -> router_decision -> final_sku. Without that we mis-credit cache savings.

james: Implementation note: adding the lineage means we either increase event size or attach a reference id and upload compact lineage maps. Prefer the ref-id approach to avoid blowing up ingestion.

ada: Ref-id sounds good. We can have an event: {"qpath_id": "uuid", "route": "search_v2", "tokens_in": 120, "cache_hit": true, "final_sku": "rwd-3b-quant"}. Put full lineage in separate table keyed by qpath_id.

nina: UX question: when we show cache savings, should we surface 'apportioned' savings (split across routes that share prefetch) or show a single owner with a note? Customers get confused when savings disappear.

ryan: Prefer apportioned with explanation. Maybe a toggle: 'Show apportioned savings' vs 'Show credited savings'. Default to apportioned for internal teams.

ada: Also think about canary/rollout effects — for canaries we should show a projected delta if routing splits are changed. Small simulation: slider to shift 10% traffic from rwd-3b to rwd-3b-quant and project monthly token savings.

james: Telemetry contract: add fields -> qpath_id, router_version, routing_policy, fallback_reason (nullable), tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit (bool), prefetch_count. Make everything optional except qpath_id + tokens_in.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new schema change "qpath-lineage-v1" staged to canary cluster 'canary-east-1' in 2m :rocket:

nina: Nice. For the panel copy: include a short explainer about apportioned vs credited savings and a link to docs. Also show confidence band for sampled estimates.

ryan: One last thing — billing/chargeback: product wants a CSV export that maps qpath_id -> chargeable_sku -> amortized_cost for reconciliation. Add export endpoint to console API.

ada: Will add POST /internal/exports/qpath-cost with filters. We'll stub with sampled estimates initially.

james: I'll draft telemetry PR (small change) and a lightweight ingest shim for lineage refs. Ping me when ops-bot shows canary up.

ada: Thanks all — I'll write a short RFC and attach basic wireframes. If anyone has strong opinions about apportioned vs single-owner defaults, speak now. :thumbsup:

ryan: +1 on apportioned default.

nina: +1

james: +1

ada: Cool, filing RFC now.
